heroSubtitle: How WellDoneDrill collects, uses and protects your personal data.

sections.body:
WellDoneDrill SRL (BCE 0801.727.368), Rue des Anciens Étangs 40, 1190 Forest, Belgium is the controller of the personal data collected via the welldonedrill.energy site.

Contact: info@welldonedrill.energy
sections.title: Data controller

sections.body: As part of your use of the site, we collect the following data:
items: Contact / quote form: first name, last name, email address, phone number, project address, message
Newsletter: email address and communication preferences
User account: first name, last name, email address, password (stored hashed)
Browsing data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, session duration (analytics cookies, only with your consent)
sections.title: Personal data collected

sections.body: We process your data for the following purposes and on the following legal bases (GDPR, art. 6):
items: Processing of your quote or contact request — legal basis: legitimate interest / performance of a contract
Sending the newsletter — legal basis: explicit consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR)
Management of your user account — legal basis: performance of a contract
Audience measurement and site improvement (GA4, GTM) — legal basis: consent
Personalised ads (Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag) — legal basis: consent
sections.title: Purposes and legal bases of the processing

sections.body: Your data is kept for the following periods:
items: Contact data and quote requests: 3 years after the last contact
Newsletter: until unsubscription, then deletion within 30 days
User account: until account deletion + 1 year (legal obligations)
Browsing data via analytics cookies: 13 months maximum (in line with the APD's recommendations)
sections.title: Retention period

sections.body: Your data may be passed to the following processors, strictly within the scope of providing the service:
items: Vercel Inc. (web hosting) — United States — transfer governed by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)
Google LLC (Analytics 4, Tag Manager) — United States — transfer governed by SCCs; IP anonymisation setting enabled
Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd (Meta Pixel) — Ireland / United States — only with your prior consent
LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company (LinkedIn Insight Tag) — Ireland / United States — only with your prior consent
sections.title: Recipients and international transfers

sections.body: In accordance with the GDPR and the Belgian law of 30 July 2018, you have the following rights over your personal data:
items: Right of access: obtain a copy of your data
Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
Right to restriction of processing
Right to data portability
Right to object to processing
Right to withdraw your consent at any time, without retroactive effect
sections.title: Your rights

sections.body:
To exercise your rights, send your request to: info@welldonedrill.energy

We will respond within a maximum of 30 days. If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Authority (APD):
Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels — www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be
sections.title: How to exercise your rights
